parsed.why: No trans-specific offence and a self-declaration recognition tradition with courts granting individual relief; but documented harassment of visibly trans people in public and government offices, rising official hate speech, and no clear document procedure.

Unenforced buggery statute is secondary; decisive are extreme documented hostility, police who harass trans women and never investigate anti-LGBT violence, birth-sex custody placement with severe prisoner violence, and complete impunity.

Gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime provisions in force, institutions actually working (official prosecuted for beheading incitement), NGO legal aid and health services, visible Pride; inconsistent implementation and political hate speech keep it short of high safety.

No criminalisation, and reported violence is punished; but an ambiguous age-of-consent offence is used as a police bribery pretext, no anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse exists, attitudes hostile, and trans-specific exposure is undocumented.

State-engineered discovery: police register, fake-meeting entrapment, contact harvesting, extortion, raids with forced HIV testing and officer sexual abuse; no SOGI protection, no care, entirely negative attitudes and religious condemnation.
